Holon Phantoms

Released May 1, 2006 · 111 cards

Holon Phantoms is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on May 1, 2006. Its main set has 110 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (111 in total). It includes 91 Pokémon, 9 Trainer and 11 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

14 illustrators worked on Holon Phantoms. Most cards: Mitsuhiro Arita (18), Masakazu Fukuda (14), Kagemaru Himeno (12), Midori Harada (11), Atsuko Nishida (10), Ryo Ueda (10), Kouki Saitou (9), Hajime Kusajima (6).
